items.raw_excerpt: En esta edición de Congreso Futuro en Cooperativa, conversamos con Julieta Flores, estudiante de 17 años del Colegio Fénix de San Antonio, nombrada primera embajadora latinoamericana de la Red Internacional de Embajadores de Física y Mecánica Cuántica por su proyecto de creación de una red científica regional juvenil. items.summary_en: Julieta Flores, a 17-year-old student from Colegio Fénix in San Antonio, Chile, is the first Latin American ambassador of the International Network of Physics and Quantum Mechanics Ambassadors. Her project builds a regional youth science network. She appeared on the science program Congreso Futuro to talk about her work.

items.summary_en: People in a village want cameras because supercars drive very fast through their streets. They worry about safety. They hope cameras will make drivers slow down.

items.raw_excerpt: "Livro é uma ocasião para conversar", diz Carla Madeira na Festa Literária Internacional do Pelorinho, Flipelô.
items.summary_en: Writer Carla Madeira said a book is a chance to talk to people. She spoke at the Pelorinho International Literary Festival in Brazil. She thinks social media helps people get interested in books.

items.raw_excerpt: Fans of hit 1990s TV show Road to Avonlea flocked to Charlottetown this weekend to meet the cast and crew. The three-day convention included oyster and wine tastings and panel discussions.
items.summary_en: Fans of the 1990s TV show Road to Avonlea gathered in Charlottetown this weekend. They met the cast and crew. The three-day event had oyster and wine tastings and panel talks.

items.raw_excerpt: Cứ chiều chiều, dạo quanh một vòng nội thị Hà Lam, qua các con đường nhỏ, lại nghe mùi thịt bò nướng tỏa ra thơm lừng. Đó là “chỉ dấu” của một quán thịt bò nướng Hà Lam đúng điệu, níu chân thực khách tìm vào.
items.summary_en: Every evening, a walk through the small streets of Ha Lam brings the rich smell of grilled beef. It is the sign of a true Ha Lam grilled beef shop. The smell keeps customers coming back.
items.summary_ko: 매일 저녁이면 하람 시내의 작은 골목길을 걷다 보면 소고기구이의 진한 냄새가 퍼져옵니다. 그 냄새가 바로 제대로 된 하람식 소고기구이 집의 표시라, 손님들의 발길을 붙잡아 둡니다.
items.title_en: The Smell of Ha Lam Grilled Beef Draws People In

items.raw_excerpt: 'Enough is enough. Please don't spoil this special area, it does not need any more concrete boxes.'
items.summary_en: A church wants to build houses in the UK's most southerly village. Residents say the village does not need more concrete buildings. They ask the church to protect the special area.
